descriptor.name: RootBeer: su binary
descriptor.description: RootBeer calls File.exists() on su in its fixed directories and every PATH entry.

evidenceUnits.title: File.exists() of su paths
evidenceUnits.observedObject: A filesystem object named su in RootBeer's binary directories
evidenceUnits.proposition: su exists in a binary directory
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: java.io.File.exists(), which is stat(2); the shadow repeats the stat
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers for a path when stat returns success, ENOENT or ENOTDIR and /system/bin/sh is visible through the same call
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The host app's mount namespace and SELinux domain
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Existence alone does not show an executable; a negative is concealable
